subject: Pilot kickoff: success criteria, environment choices, and owners
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Lemp <claire.lemp@medisync.com>, Amandeep Singh <amandeep@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff: success criteria, environment choices, and owners

Hi Claire / Amandeep —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the time and the honest questions. This thread is a brief recap and a proposed onramp so we can lock the pilot dates and environment. I attached a quick trial-criteria template to make it easy to capture measurable success metrics.

High-level asks from our side (please confirm):
- Confirm the primary success metrics (pick up to 3): throughput (avg inference latency), top-3 intent accuracy on your test set, and cost per 1k requests. We can adapt but call these examples.
- Data sensitivity: is the dataset for the pilot de-identified PHI, regulated PHI, or non-PHI? That will determine hosting recommendations.
- Desired pilot window: suggested 3-week window starting Oct 4 (flexible).
- Preferred environment: hosted Redwood API (fastest), dedicated sandbox (reserved GPUs + isolated tenant), or VPC (customer network adjacency). If compliance requires it, we can land on dedicated sandbox or VPC.

Proposed owners (can update):
- Redwood commercial / kickoff owner: Ben Carter (contracting / scheduling)
- Redwood trial ops / infra owner: Marissa Cole (provisioning + onboarding)
- PM / success owner: Evelyn Hart (overall trial plan and acceptance)

Next concrete steps I propose:
1) Claire/Amandeep confirm data sensitivity + pick success metrics (this week).
2) Redwood shares short checklist for infra + network needs (Marissa will send).
3) We prepare a simple mutual action plan and finalize start date.

Attachments: trial-criteria-template.xlsx (fill the right-hand column and send back)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if helpful.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Claire Lemp <claire.lemp@medisync.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Amandeep Singh <amandeep@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: success criteria, environment choices, and owners

Thanks, Evelyn — nice recap. Quick answers from our side:
- Success metrics: we care most about (1) clinical-entity extraction F1 on our holdout set, (2) average token latency under 350ms for common queries, and (3) CPU+GPU cost per 1k inference calls (we'll supply a proxy workload).
- Data sensitivity: pilot data will be de-identified clinical notes (we still treat this as sensitive; legal wants minimal egress and audit logs).
- Preferred start: Oct 11 kickoff, 3-week window fine.
- Environment: legal is leaning toward a dedicated sandbox with tenant isolation; Amandeep (CTO) will confirm if VPC is needed.

A couple of asks for you:
1) please send SOC2 + a short network adjacency note (which ports, outbound endpoints) so infrastructure can review.
2) we have a security questionnaire that I'll attach separately — happy if you want to prefill anything on the infra side.

I'll fill the template by EOD Thursday. CC'ing Amandeep for visibility.

—Claire
Claire Lemp
Head of Partnerships | MediSync Health
claire.lemp@medisync.com

Claire — great, this is helpful. Short commercial/ops note:

We can support the dedicated sandbox for the pilot (isolated tenant + reserved capacity) and make sure audit logging is enabled. If MediSync confirms no full VPC requirement, dedicated sandbox is typically the fastest path (2–4 business days to provision, assuming network peering if needed). If VPC is required, lead time is closer to 10+ business days (security review + network changes).

Proposed quick responsibilities and deliveries:
- Ben Carter: finalize trial SOW/POC commercial terms and schedule (by Sep 15).
- Marissa Cole: infra checklist + provisioning plan (deliverable: infra-readiness checklist + sample peering doc) — target Sep 10.
- Evelyn Hart: success criteria doc + acceptance tests (EOD Sep 9) — Evelyn will consolidate Claire's inputs into the template.

Marissa — can you drop the infra checklist and the minimal network adjacency note Claire asked for? I can loop in contracts once we have the start date and environment locked.

Thanks all — pairing up on the SLA & audit details will be critical given the sensitivity.

—Ben
